rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to say that an object is made of plastic.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seoi2 zeon1 hai6 gaau1 zou6 ge3

rows.note: For everyday material talk, 膠 is the all-purpose spoken choice for plastic; use 塑膠 when greater technical precision is needed.

example.english: This plastic box is very durable.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaau1 hap6 hou2 gam1 jung6

rows.note: Use 塑膠 for the precise or technical name of the synthetic material rather than the broader colloquial 膠.

example.english: This type of plastic can withstand high temperatures.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 sou3 gaau1 ho2 ji5 noi6 gou1 wan1

rows.note: In a payment context, 卡 refers to the credit or debit card being used instead of cash.

example.english: Can I use plastic to pay?
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 kaa1 bei2 cin2 dak1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is not genuine or is a cheap imitation.

example.english: These branded sneakers are plastic, so don’t buy them.
example.traditional: 呢對名牌波鞋係假嘅，唔好買。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 meng4 paai4 bo1 haai4 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 hou2 maai5

rows.note: Use this for a person who is conspicuously insincere and putting on a polished act.

example.english: They’re always being plastic and pretending to care about people; it makes me cringe.
example.traditional: 佢成日假惺惺咁扮關心人，睇到我都尷尬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaa2 sing1 sing1 gam2 baan6 gwaan1 sam1 jan4 tai2 dou2 ngo5 dou1 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Use 偽人 for a hypocritical, affected, or fake person rather than for literal plastic.

example.english: They always act so refined, but they’re a plastic.
example.traditional: 佢成日扮到好有品味，其實係個偽人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 dou3 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6 kei4 sat6 hai6 go3 ngai6 jan4
